text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Man, what a race to watch! For me, today was all about Mr. C.B.! Ah man, she just HAS to run for the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
C.B. was so cool, wasn't she...
I just can't take my eyes off her...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Mmm-mmph...! That was such a good race...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"CB! That was so cool!
Good luck next time too! We're rooting for you!!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah... haah...! 
Running like that... 
and your breath is already... back under control...?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"And the stands... are they only able
to see CB, or what...?! ...Still—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "—Haaaaah!!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Competing in the real race made me realize it all over again...!
C.B.'s sheer power...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
She's on a completely different level from me and the rest... sheer absurdity...!
In a flash, she's crossing over to "the other side"...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, without a doubt, they're going to
be ridiculously stronger than today...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (It's precisely because you're the kind of person who leaves conventional wisdom behind and just keeps surging ahead—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I want to surpass them...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Going out to welcome Katsuragi Ace, who had given it her absolute all—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“—Thanks, Trainer.
For letting me run in today's race.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my spirits are so high right now...!
I can't wait to run my next race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems Katsuragi Ace is not at all overwhelmed
by Mr. C.B.'s brilliance, even when facing her directly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from it, the fire in her heart
burns even brighter than before she ran...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: What is it? It's getting awfully noisy over there—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for your hard work in the Kyodo News Hai!
That was a magnificent run...! How are you feeling about the Triple Crown path after this?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
A run like that is sure to raise the fans' expectations!
There's a massive demand to see her enter the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Let's see—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer!
Can I go over to CB's place right now!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Please...!!
I need to tell her!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "Fight me one more time"...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Cee Beeee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—If you're hesitating, then come to the Satsuki Sho!!
And face me head-to-head!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ace—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Katsuragi Ace...!?
What on earth is this—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Keep the camera rolling...!
This is about to get interesting...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Not just the Satsuki Sho!
The Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho, too!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: It's a best-of-three showdown between you and me in the Classic Triple Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha, ahahaha...!!
Man, Ace really is something else...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Sure, let's do it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'm running the Classic Triple Crown too.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Oooooohhh!?)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
First is the Satsuki Sho—
We settle things there, Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! That's a promise!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: "With Mr. C.B.'s declaration to challenge the Classic Triple Crown, Twinkle Series fans everywhere seem to be brimming with excitement!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Well, everyone was hoping for it.
I'm sure many fans were relieved to hear it straight from her own mouth."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"I, too, have been looking forward to seeing
what she can do, so I can't wait."

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: "‘Katsuragi Ace throwing down the gauntlet at Mr. C.B. was quite the fiery speech, wasn't it~?’"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It really showed me on screen!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"She's an Umamusume on the rise, but Mr. C.B. is clearly
superior in terms of raw potential.
It'll be interesting to see how she fights against such an opponent."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Above us, huh?
I bet deep down, they're badmouthing us way worse.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: People online keep calling me 'out of my depth' and stuff, so—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's more like, "Bring it on!"
I'm used to being underestimated, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll show 'em all!
Those guys looking down on me... and CB, too!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, let's get started today too!
My warrior's journey
is far from over, after all!
choice_data_list: Let's give it all we've got!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "Kyodo News Hai" came to an end,
granting new strength to move forward toward the future—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! It never eeeends!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (I was so wrapped up in the Kyodo News Hai that I forgot my homework?! What an idiot I am...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(If I don't finish this today,
it'll affect tomorrow's training...!
Nwaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, there you are.
Good work, Ace-chan.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Heard you forgot your assignment, and wow, you really did! We'll give you a hand~

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh, seriously!?
Honestly, that's a huge help...! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeah! All done~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, you two!
Because of you, I can turn this in first thing tomorrow morning!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're welcome.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely make it up to you next time! Wanna grab some food on me? Or maybe—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: "No, no~! In fact, this is our way of saying thanks!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: "...I saw the footage of Ace-chan challenging CB-chan after the Kyodo News Hai."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
You know, what you did, S-cchi...
it really encouraged all of us.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Back when S-cchi first enrolled,
to be totally blunt... she had a super rough time, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: "Whaaat!? S-cchi, you do this much muscle training every single day!?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Yeah. I mean, if I don't train hard,
I won't be able to catch up, right?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
""T-There's a limit to everything...!
You need to rest properly and split up muscle groups!
Resting is just as important when it comes to muscle training!""

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...! No one's ever taught me stuff like that before.
Mind if I hear a bit more about it?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, that's fine, but...
I see... So you never even got taught at a club, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
—Coming all the way to Tokyo alone and enrolling here...
it felt like I was learning things everyone else already knew, over and over.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Ah~. That reminds me of when someone saw me caring for my shoes my own way and using the same pair forever, and looked totally creeped out...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
And yet, Ace-chan didn't care about the differences between us or the other girls,
and kept working hard without ever losing heart, ever since that time.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Look forward, keep moving forward—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
—We've finally made it to the point where we can stand
at the pinnacle of our generation and say, 'Let's settle this.'

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Seeing you stand tall without backing down an inch, even right in front of CB-chan, Ace-chan... you were so incredibly cool...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
“—And that made me think,
'We can't let ourselves lose either.'”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: "It made me realize all over again that Esc-chi, who struggled the most out of all of us, kept working the hardest."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
That's why we have to do our best too,
right where we are...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: I realized... that I have to fight!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: You two...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(It's different this time...!
Those eyes... They haven't given up!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: "We're gonna look ahead just like Esc-chi and become someone we can be prouder of than we are now!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
So give it your all, Ace-chan...!
As our—"Ace"!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ......Thanks, you two.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely live up to those words.
So, let's fight together...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
âIn the classroom bathed in the setting sun, that vow echoed quietly,
yet with undeniable strength.
